source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Directory types use the URI scheme instead of numeric dirType. Directory count increments before trying childCardCount; a directory throwing NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED does not abort the whole report. The current test includes an LDAP directory count but does not prove remote LDAP contacts are loaded/counted. Keep the narrow best-effort contact operation and preserve other directory results.
title: Address-book telemetry counts directories even when contact enumeration is unsupported
